issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE 'python:3.12' is duplicated across Python and TypeScript with no single source of truth.
issues.detail: The constant lives in pipeline.py, Commands.ts (getDefaultBaseImage fallback), CellMetadataEditor.tsx, and the jinja template fallback chain. The RPC was added to centralize this, yet hardcoded copies remain and will drift on the next version bump. Trust the RPC and remove the TS literals, or define once and inject at build time.

issues.description: _set_base_image silently changes runtime behavior from kfp default to pinned python:3.12 on pod inspection failure.
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = '' deferred to kfp's own default resolution. Now it pins 'python:3.12' whenever pod introspection fails, a real runtime change for every affected pipeline. The comment still says 'Use kfp default image'. This semantic change is piggybacked on a UI PR and should be split out or reverted.

issues.description: Replacing the inline Input with a 5%-wide 'IMAGE' Button plus modal is a UX regression.
issues.detail: The old UI exposed the current base image as a directly editable, readable field. The new UI hides state behind a button labeled IMAGE that opens a Dialog, adding a click for the common edit case and removing at-a-glance visibility. The 5% width will not fit the label at most viewport sizes. A placeholder or adjacent label on the original Input would have sufficed.

issues.description: createBaseImageText now always renders an element, breaking the prior empty-string sentinel contract.
issues.detail:
The function previously returned '' when no baseImage was set, letting callers skip rendering. It now unconditionally renders a

with 'Base Image: (default)'. Non-step cells (imports, functions, skip) may now display meaningless base image lines unless callers gate by cellType, which was not audited.

issues.description: Repeated four-term fallback chain 'baseImage || pipelineBaseImage || defaultBaseImage || DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE' across multiple sites.
issues.detail: The same precedence chain appears in InlineMetadata, the Dialog placeholder, and the jinja template (in a different order). Any precedence change must be made in lockstep across four sites. Resolve the effective image once at one boundary (ideally server-side in compiler.py) and pass a single resolved value down via context instead of prop drilling.

issues.description: RPC round-trip to fetch a compile-time constant is gratuitous given the hardcoded fallback.
issues.detail: get_default_base_image is an RPC that returns a string literal defined in Python source, called on every panel init with a try/catch and a hardcoded TS fallback that mirrors it. Either trust the RPC (drop the literal fallback) or replace the RPC with a build-time injection. Currently you pay for both.

synthesis.summary: The panel unanimously rejects this PR in its current form. The same 'python:3.12' string is hardcoded in Python, in a TypeScript constant, in a Commands.ts fallback, and in the jinja template — defeating the RPC's stated purpose and guaranteeing drift. The pipeline.py change silently swaps kfp's default resolution for a pinned image on pod-inspection failure, a runtime semantic change smuggled into a 'display' PR. The UI also regresses: an editable Input is replaced by a 5%-wide button that hides current state behind a modal. Consolidate the default to one source, split the semantic change into its own commit, and reconsider the Dialog in favor of the original inline field.
